lines.en: I sweep my tail through the weeds.
I swim fast in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我露出牙，在水面下跟着你。
lines.en: I bare my teeth and follow beneath the surface.
I circle a sunken post.
I stir rings in the water.
I hug the muddy bottom.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴的水里，我们两三条一起。
lines.en: In lush cave water, two or three of us.
My fins cut the water.
I chase a small fish.
I turn sharply.
I drift up by the weeds.
I nudge the floating leaves aside.
My shadow slides over the mud.
I swim the shoreline.
I stop, my tail still moving.
I slip into darker water.
I hang still near the bottom.

lines.zh: 鳃盖一开一合，我等血味。
lines.en: My gill covers open and close; I wait for blood.
Weeds brush my flank.

lines.zh: 我在等水面碎掉的那一下。
lines.en: I wait for the surface to break.
My teeth click together.
Bubbles rise from the mud.

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，背鳍划开水面。
lines.en: I turn half a circle and my dorsal fin cuts the surface.
Sunlight reaches the shallows.
My fins fan gently.

lines.zh: 岸上的脚步一响，我就转过来。
lines.en: A footstep on the bank and I turn toward it.
I sink into the mud.
My back shows at the surface.
I wait for something to fall in.
This water is murky.
Your feet are in the water.

lines.zh: 水只到你的膝盖，退路很长。
lines.en: The water only reaches your knees; your retreat is long.

lines.zh: 你袖子上的血，已经在滴水。
lines.en: Blood on your sleeve is already dripping.
Water sounds as you move.
My teeth are smaller than your blade.
But I have many.
Your leg is the easiest bite.
Don't test the water.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖泡在水里，正好。
lines.en: Your knees are soaked — perfect.
I'm right on the bottom.

lines.zh: 鳞片翻起两片，血散在水里。
lines.en: Two scales peel up and blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 丛林的水里，我们三只一起。
lines.en: In jungle water, three of us together.
Blood leaks from my gills.

lines.zh: 我钻进丛林水草的最深处。
lines.en: I burrow into the deepest jungle weeds.
Scales fell; I back into the weeds.
A piranha's teeth stay sharp, even chipped.
The water holds me up.
I flick my tail and dodge.
Your boot is thicker than I expected.
One more bite.
Is that a chunk of meat?
Throw it in the water, not on the bank.
I smell blood.
These meat scraps are not enough for all of us.
What falls in the water is mine.

lines.zh: 你手指垂下来，就是我的了。
lines.en: Let your fingers dangle, and they are mine.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，看清了水深。
lines.en: I circle once and gauge the depth.
That blood smells fresh.
Throw another; I have not had my fill.
That meat is nothing next to your leg.
Your foot came down on me.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩下来，我侧身弹开。
lines.en: Your foot comes down and I dart aside.
My teeth grazed you.
Water splashes up a meter.
I press against your calf.
You move, I sink.
At that touch I turn away.
Two or three of us bite at once.
The water's gone cloudy.
Step again and I bite.
We don't speak of that in the water.
My mate must swim fast.
No gills, so you can't stay under.
I care more about the next bite.
My kind fill this channel.
Don't crowd me.
I'm going to keep my water.
The current carries such thoughts off.
I only know blood.
Go away.
A bit of meat, I snap it up.
My mouth is full of sand, so I spit it out.
Too hard to bite through.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游，水草刮着鳞。
lines.en: I carry it in my teeth; weeds scrape my scales.
Something glints on the bottom.
I don't chew. I swallow.
Another fish is watching.
I get there first.
Barely a few bites.
It sank. Never mind.
You're in the water.
This distance will do.
My blood runs fast.
The smell of blood is strong.
I flatten and dart in.
You can't run fast in water.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经露出来，你别动。
lines.en: My teeth are already bared; do not move.
Your calf is in the water.
One bite is all.
Don't scramble for the bank yet.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚踝绕第三圈。
lines.en: I circle your ankle a third time.
The water's murky, you can't see me.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下你的腿，又退。
lines.en: I bump your leg and retreat.
Your movements have slowed.
Your blood is leaking into the water.
That smell drives me wild.
Another half circle.
Your back is to the water.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我的牙就够到。
lines.en: Half a step closer and my teeth reach.
At this point.

lines.zh: 我咬进你的小腿，甩了一下。
lines.en: I bite into your calf and twist.
My teeth tear an opening.
I twist underwater.
You kick to shake me off.
I bite down once more.
I jostle in the school for a bite.
I'm kicked away.
I turn and come back.
Your leg is wobbling.
This time I bite deeper.
A flash of white under the surface.
I rise out of the silt.
The weeds shifted.
A fish darts past.
I circle in the shallows.
The water is warm. Good.
I show my dorsal fin.
I sink again.
This water is ours.
Something walks on the bank.

lines.zh: 水面都烫了，我的鳃合上。
lines.en: The water heats, my gills clamp.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔进水里，翻了身。
lines.en: I fall in and flip over.

lines.zh: 水进了我的鳃，我挣不出。
lines.en: Water floods my gills, I can't work free.
The water shakes, my ears ring.

lines.zh: 这东西穿进水里扎住我。
lines.en: It cut the water and caught me.
Magic stiffens all my fins.
Hunger softens my teeth.
Lightning in the water, my body jerks.
No water to swim in, in the void.
